pitch_detail.notes: Approach glacier travel to the base of the bergschrund below the ridge.
Bergschrund crossing/ice step.
Rising traverse (~1,000 ft) below the rock buttress.
Waterfall ice step encountered on the upper traverse.
Crux rock chimney around 12,000-12,200 ft.
Remaining technical climbing above the crux before the terrain eases into snow slopes toward Liberty Cap.
Loose ridge crest, described as 'virgin choss'
Straddling the ridge across rock 'the consistency of feta cheese'
Continued loose climbing to the summit area, described as 'best forgotten'
Obvious crack up the face to the U-notch on the ridge
Excellent cracks on the opposite side of the notch
Classic exposed knife-edge ridge climbing ('B-Basin knife riding'), ending in a short downclimb
Ridge broadens; mellow scrambling to the true summit
~150 ft to gain the sub-summit after the rappel/glacier traverse
~50 ft of well-protected but loose-rock climbing to the true summit
Lower névé/ice slope from the Chickamin Glacier, briefly deviating to skirt the bergschrund.
Direct line up the consistent-angle center of the face.
Angle eases; short rock/snow scramble to the summit.
Ice ribbon on the initial slabs
Mostly moderate terrain interrupted by three distinct steeper steps
~100 feet of near-vertical ice at roughly three-quarters height, leading to steep, often runnelled snow
Rotten ice, shale, and drytooling moves up to roughly 95-degree angles
Summit cornices may require tunneling through to reach the ridge
Buck Creek Trail to Chiwawa River Trail, then cross-country to roughly 6,580 ft
pitch_detail.pitch: Trailhead to bench below Chiwawa's east ridge

pitch_detail.notes: Crampons/axe recommended crossing firm snow slopes to the Chiwawa-Fortress col
Loose rock gully gains the crest of the East Ridge
pitch_detail.pitch: Col to East Ridge via gully

pitch_detail.notes: Improved rock quality; exposed, unroped 4th-class step just below the summit
